title: Collect for Coverage, Replay with Evidence: Adaptive and Efficient On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.34756v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fully online on-policy distillation (OPD) is costly for long-horizon agents because each update depends on fresh environment rollouts. Prefix replay offers an efficient alternative by sampling current-student responses from stored histories, reducing idle time for long-tail rollouts and allowing each collected trajectory to support multiple updates. However, our analysis of the complete prefix replay pipeline identifies two limitations in long-horizon settings. In trajectory collection, teacher-only trajectories miss student-induced histories, while broader history coverage can reduce teacher reliability. In trajectory reuse, fixed position-based schedules cannot identify critical decisions that may occur at any trajectory depth. We introduce CARE-OPD (Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence) to address both limitations. translated_title: 收集以求覆盖，回放以证据：面向长程智能体的自适应高效在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.34756v1 公告类型：cross。摘要：对于长程智能体而言，完全在线的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）代价高昂，因为每次更新都依赖全新的环境交互轨迹。前缀回放提供了一种高效的替代方案：通过从存储的历史中采样当前学生模型的响应，减少了长尾轨迹带来的空闲时间，并使每条收集到的轨迹能够支持多次更新。然而，我们对完整前缀回放流程的分析发现，在长程场景中存在两个局限。在轨迹收集阶段，仅由教师生成的轨迹会遗漏由学生引入的历史，而更广泛的历史覆盖又可能降低教师的可靠性。在轨迹复用阶段，固定的基于位置的调度无法识别可能出现在轨迹任意深度处的关键决策。我们提出 CARE-OPD（Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence，为覆盖而收集、以证据回放）来解决这两个局限。学生种子教师补全与响应级置信度门控在扩展历史覆盖的同时过滤不可靠内容（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出CARE-OPD框架，通过学生种子教师补全和响应级置信度门控扩大历史覆盖并过滤不可靠教师信号，同时以证据自适应地回放轨迹中任意深度的关键决策，从而实现面向长程智能体的自适应且高效的前缀回放式在线策略蒸馏。
en_tdlr: CARE-OPD enables adaptive and efficient prefix-replay-based on-policy distillation for long-horizon agents by expanding history coverage via student-seeded teacher completions with response-level confidence gating, and adaptively replaying critical decisions at any trajectory depth with evidence.
